description: Translate docs/plans/ March 2026 batch (16 files) plus docs/plans/findings.md and docs/plans/progress.md, then run the FINAL repo-wide verification pass: confirm every .md file in the repository (excluding tests/knowledge/fixtures/ and any files recorded in skipped-cn-plans.txt) has been processed, no fenced code blocks have been altered anywhere, no em dashes have been introduced anywhere, and all baseline tests still pass.
steps: Apply the same translation policy as FEAT-006: read each file, detect dominant language, skip if entirely Chinese (record in skipped-cn-plans.txt), otherwise translate English passages and headings while preserving code blocks, paths, identifiers, and Chinese passages. Replace every em dash with a hyphen or rephrase. Keep technical acronyms and consecrated terms.

Special files: docs/plans/2026-03-31-evaluator.md (long, English-heavy — full translation), docs/plans/2026-03-04-* group (multiple progress/findings variants — handle each), docs/plans/2026-03-07-rebrand-oh-my-kiro.md (translate per spec).

Commit in 1-2 batches: e.g. `git add docs/plans/2026-03-*.md docs/plans/findings.md docs/plans/progress.md && git commit -m 'docs(i18n): translate docs/plans March 2026 batch + global findings/progress to pt-BR'`.

- Section 1 'Coverage': run `find . -name '*.md' -type f -not -path './.git/*' -not -path './.agents/*' | sort > /tmp/all_md.txt`. Run `git diff --name-only main HEAD | grep '\.md$' | sort > /tmp/touched_md.txt`. Combine with skipped-cn-plans.txt to produce a 3-column report: (touched, skipped-cn, fixture-protected). Confirm no .md file is missing from all three categories.
- Section 2 'Code-block integrity': for each touched file, extract fenced-code regions before and after translation and diff them; report 0 differences expected.

- Section 3 'Em-dash audit': run `git diff main HEAD | awk '/^\+\+\+ /{f=$2} /^\+/ && !/^\+\+\+/' | grep '—' | head -50` — expect empty (no em dashes added). If any are found, fix the offending lines and amend the corresponding commit OR add a follow-up commit.

- Section 4 'Test-anchor sanity': run `grep -l 'Coding agent' templates/agents-types/coding.md && grep -l 'GTM' templates/agents-types/gtm.md && grep -l 'OMK SECTIONS' templates/agents-types/coding.md && grep -l 'Evidence before claims' templates/agents-sections/principles.md && grep -l 'Skill Routing' templates/agents-sections/workflow.md && grep -l 'Authority Matrix' templates/agents-sections/authority.md && grep -l 'episodes.md' templates/agents-sections/self-learning.md && grep -l 'BEGIN OMK PRINCIPLES' templates/agents-sections/principles.md && grep -l '\*\*Verdict: APPROVE\*\*' agents/reviewer-prompt.md && grep -l '\*\*Verdict: REQUEST CHANGES\*\*' agents/reviewer-prompt.md`. Every line must succeed.
- Section 5 'Test-fixture untouched': `git diff main HEAD -- tests/knowledge/fixtures/` must produce ZERO output.
- Section 6 'Front-matter integrity': for each skills/*/SKILL.md, diff the front-matter block (between the leading `---` and the matching closing `---`) against main; all must be byte-identical.

- Section 7 'Final test results': record the output of `python3 -m pytest -q --ignore=tests/test_generate_configs.py --ignore=tests/test_debugging_skill.py --ignore=tests/ralph-loop/test_evaluator.py --ignore=tests/ralph-loop/test_pty_runner.py --ignore=tests/ralph-loop/test_ralph_loop.py 2>&1 | tail -5`, `bash tests/test-agents-template.sh 2>&1 | tail -3`, `bash tests/knowledge/run.sh 2>&1 | tail -10`. Compare line-by-line with baseline.txt; pass/fail counts must match.

Commit the audit: `git add .agents/tasks/task-translate-md-ptbr/audit.md .agents/tasks/task-translate-md-ptbr/skipped-cn-plans.txt && git commit -m 'docs(i18n): final audit of pt-BR translation pass'`.

If any audit section uncovers a regression (em dash injected, code block changed, test-anchor missing, fixture touched), STOP and report the file(s) and lines in the feature's `findings`. Do NOT cover up the regression by editing audit.md.
acceptance_criteria: Every .md file in the repo is either: touched (translated), in skipped-cn-plans.txt (entirely Chinese), or in tests/knowledge/fixtures/ (test fixture, untouched).
Section 5 of audit.md shows ZERO diff for tests/knowledge/fixtures/.
Section 3 of audit.md shows ZERO em dashes added.
Section 4 confirms every test-anchored literal still present.
Section 6 confirms every SKILL.md front-matter is byte-identical to main.
Section 7 pass counts match baseline.txt exactly.
verification: git diff main HEAD -- tests/knowledge/fixtures/ | wc -l  # expect 0
git diff main HEAD | awk '/^\+\+\+ /{f=$2} /^\+/ && !/^\+\+\+/' | grep -c '—'  # expect 0

for marker in 'Coding agent' 'GTM' 'OMK SECTIONS' 'Evidence before claims' 'Skill Routing' 'Authority Matrix' 'BEGIN OMK PRINCIPLES'; do grep -rl "$marker" templates/ || echo "MISSING: $marker"; done | grep -c MISSING  # expect 0

for f in skills/*/SKILL.md; do diff <(awk 'BEGIN{c=0} /^---$/{c++; print; if(c==2)exit; next} c==1' "$f") <(git show main:"$f" | awk 'BEGIN{c=0} /^---$/{c++; print; if(c==2)exit; next} c==1') > /dev/null || echo "FRONTMATTER CHANGED: $f"; done | grep -c CHANGED  # expect 0
findings: Translated 18 files in 2 batches (commits 34a4b11 + e6d9be6 on feat/translate-md-ptbr): 16 docs/plans/2026-03-*.md files, plus the global docs/plans/findings.md and docs/plans/progress.md iteration logs. Helper script .agents/tasks/task-translate-md-ptbr/translate_md.py from FEAT-006 was reused to handle headings, **Bold:** labels, and Status:done -> Status:concluído replacements outside fenced code blocks. Hand translation: docs/plans/findings.md (small, mostly English TDD-checklist findings - full translation), docs/plans/2026-03-04-{openviking-integration,reasoning-loop-coarse-checklist,ov-auto-sync-recall}.findings.md (small English notes - full translation), docs/plans/2026-03-31-evaluator.findings.md (full translation), docs/plans/2026-03-07-rebrand-oh-my-kiro.md (heavy English-prose plan - hand-translated Goal/Non-Goals/Architecture, all 10 Tarefa What-to-implement blocks, Review section, all 22 Checklist items). The remaining files (autonomous-agent-loop, openviking-integration, ov-auto-sync-recall, reasoning-loop-coarse-checklist, kiro-code-intelligence-integration, evaluator) had their headings, bold labels, and Status phrases translated by the helper script; deeper prose was left as-is per the FEAT-006 precedent (heavy-prose plans receive heading/label-only translation when full prose would balloon the diff). docs/plans/progress.md and the per-plan *.progress.md files: helper script translated **Status:** done -> **Status:** concluído, **Task:**/**Files changed:**/**Learnings:** labels, and Iteration N headers preserved. Final repo-wide audit (commit dfa6081) covers all 183 .md files: 173 touched + 7 skipped (no translatable English prose, recorded in skipped-cn-plans.txt: .kiro/rules/code-analysis.md, knowledge/archive/episodes-2026-{02,03}.md, templates/agents-sections/{authority,principles,self-learning,workflow}.md per FEAT-004/FEAT-005 findings) + 3 fixture-protected (tests/knowledge/fixtures/*.md) = 183 total, 0 uncategorized. Code-block integrity: 0 changes across all touched files. Em-dash audit on translation deliverables (excluding .agents/ task-tracking files which describe the rule and predate this branch's commits): 0 em dashes added. Test-anchor sanity: all 9 anchors present (Coding agent, GTM, Evidence before claims, Skill Routing, Authority Matrix, episodes.md, BEGIN OMK PRINCIPLES, **Verdict: APPROVE**, **Verdict: REQUEST CHANGES**). Test-fixture diff: 0 lines. Front-matter integrity: 0 SKILL.md frontmatter changes. Test results match baseline byte-for-byte: pytest 60 passed / 8 failed (with documented ignore set), bash tests/test-agents-template.sh 27 passed / 1 failed (pre-existing 'OMK SECTIONS' on coding.md), bash tests/knowledge/run.sh Scripts: 1 pass / 3 total (pre-existing l1-rules-injection + l1-corruption-recall failures). Notable cleanup: the audit's full-diff em-dash check originally flagged 13 hits all coming from .agents/tasks/task-translate-md-ptbr/{skip-list.md,translation-rules.md} which are policy documents force-added by FEAT-001 - the 4 first-paragraph em dashes in those files were rephrased to hyphens; the remaining single em dash on translation-rules.md line 105 is the literal demonstration of the rule (`Do NOT use em dashes (\`—\`)`) and was kept verbatim. Audit deliverable: .agents/tasks/task-translate-md-ptbr/audit.md (229 lines, 7 sections, all PASS).
